'''Star Tours Flight 806''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the gate for its planned arrival at 1045 hours was changed to Gate 3A. It was scheduled to depart again at 1140.
